ENTITY Bench runs one job: a controlled CPU benchmark for local LLMs.

Workload: llama-bench PP 512 / TG 128 on the model you pick, with a thermal cooldown before every pass.

3-ARM mode is an ablation. naive = 8 threads across all cores. threads-only = the tuned thread count with core pinning off (an upstream llama.cpp -t N run). auto = the tuned count pinned to the performance cores. The middle arm splits the gain between thread count and pinning.

SUSTAINED mode runs threads-only vs auto back-to-back with no cooldown, so you see who throttles first.

Power and tok/W need the phone UNPLUGGED - they are hidden while charging.

Every result is saved on the device and exportable as raw per-pass CSV. No network, no accounts, nothing leaves the phone.

ENTITY\'s finding - that thread count earns the decode speed-up and core pinning is device-dependent - was measured on two phones. Sending your result makes it a claim about Arm silicon rather than about two devices. Off by default. Summary numbers only: no telemetry trace, no accounts, no identifier that links two of your runs. Every submission records whether the phone was charging, because power readings taken while charging are the charger\'s, not the workload\'s.
